parsed.assumptions: Grant table as stated in the mechanism doc: alpha (fixt-alpha) is granted only acme and bravo (fixt-bravo) is granted only globex. The eight recorded requests are the complete run, and each 403 means the authorization middleware rejected the request before the business route ran, so no tenant state was read or changed. The run reports no read-back of acme or globex after the 403 writes; the 403 status alone is taken as evidence that no write landed. Every request was classifiable, so none is UNKNOWN. Scope is limited to this recorded run with the normal case, seed 1, on local test tenants; untested endpoints such as /admin/* are not covered.
parsed.rationale: The invariant is forall s,t: accessed[s][t] -> grant[s][t]. The four successful requests (200) were alpha->acme read and write and bravo->globex read and write, and all four fall within the principal's grant. The writes were confirmed by reading back state through the owning tenant's own principal. All four cross-tenant attempts (alpha->globex read and write, bravo->acme read and write) received 403 Forbidden, which is the specified failure result for a principal that is not granted the tenant. No ungranted access succeeded, so the tenant_isolation property holds on this run.
